text:
ops-bot: ALERT: region eu-north1 — control-plane heartbeat silence detected. 1976543210. Affected: serving, provisioning, autoscaler. Severity: potential full-region outage. Pager: @sasha

sasha: I'm taking lead. Switching to #incidents and creating bridge. Anyone already seeing customer impact?

kevin: Grafana shows API latency -> 5xx surge then total silence from control-plane endpoints in eu-north1. Node heartbeats stopped ~1976543198. BGP peer flaps from provider at same time. Minimal pod evictions.

maria: Traceroute from control-plane -> drops at provider edge. `traceroute -n 52.88.10.1` shows hop 4 -> * * *. Provider AS shows repeated withdraws.

sasha: Can ops confirm whether control-plane is reachable from inter-region? `ssh controller-eu-north1` times out.

kevin: Confirmed. From eu-central1 control-plane -> `curl https://api.eu-north1.redwood.internal/health` times out. But from outside cloud public IPs, most endpoints unreachable.

sam: Initiating regional fallback policy. I'll start traffic shift to eu-central1. Plan: 50% immediate, monitor error rate 5m, then 100% if healthy. Anyone object?

maria: Provider says they see "BGP route withdraw" events; their SOC engaged. ETA unknown.

kevin: Capacity note: eu-central1 has reserve `dedicated-eu-reserve` at 60% free. Autoscaler cannot provision more due to cloud GPU quota (we're at vCPU/GPU region quota). Need quota bump or use `overflow-eu` burst pool (pre-provisioned, cold). Spinning overflow nodes takes ~8-12m.

sasha: Ok. Sam, do 50% shift now. Kevin, start `overflow-eu` spinup and open quota request concurrently. Use manual announce for any existing floating IPs?

sam: Executing routing change now.

sam: ```
POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/shift
body: {"from":"eu-north1","to":"eu-central1","percent":50,"policy":"regional-fallback"}
```

kevin: Ack. Kicking off `terraform apply -target=module.overflow-eu` and contacting cloud support. Logs: `apply started at 1976543238`. Tagging `@cloud-support`.

maria: Cross-region egress will add ~2.4x cost per token for affected customers. Finance and SRE-ops notify: ping @kevin to draft cost estimate.

kevin: Also note: Serving model shards in eu-central1 are quantized variants; inference latency will increase ~30-70ms per request. We should update SLAs and alert product.

sasha: Quick canary checks: after 50% shift, monitor 5xx, tail lat p95, token cost delta. If 5xx <1% and lat p95 < 500ms, move to 100%.

ops-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/incident-1976543210. Severity set SEV2. Incident timeline created: https://issues.redwood/INC-1976543210

kevin: Overflow pool boot is at 1976543255, nodes becoming healthy at 1976543320. Autoscaler still blocked by quota.

sam: Canary 50% in flight — initial error spike down to 0.3%. Lat p95 ~420ms. Keeping at 50% for 6m.

maria: Provider update: they're doing RIB rebuild, will re-advertise in ~10-15m if stable.

sasha: Good. If provider can't reannounce, plan B is manual IP anycast announce via partner IX. Kevin, can we prep route-announce playbook?

kevin: Yes. I have playbook `netplay/ix-announce.md`. Will prep contact list and LOA. Manual announce risk: traffic scrubbing bypass and potential abuse; need security signoff.

sam: Noted. Also toggled `graceful-degradation: true` for non-critical routes to reduce tokens.

sasha: Notify Customer Success and Sales for top 10 enterprise customers in eu-north1. I'll draft message.

maria: Adding note: this incident will likely incur emergency cloud overage. Finance: please pre-authorize up to $XXk for today's burst.

kevin: Cloud support opened ticket #CS-55623 requesting quota bump and BGP clarification. ETA for quota bump unknown.

ops-bot: Update: Incident state: mitigated -> partial failover to eu-central1 in progress. Next update in 10m or on significant change.

sasha: Thanks team. Continue monitoring. Log any manual actions to the incident doc. I'll own postmortem.
